reviews.text: We loved dinner, but we waited about half an hour for a table on Saturday.
Our party of four came around seven and left when there wasn't a table available.
We sat at the counter on Sunday and the team was lovely.
The House Burger had a great char and the server remembered our side order.
The patio was lovely, but the chairs felt a little tight around our four-top.
The whipped ricotta and grilled sourdough were perfect while we waited for dinner.
Our Saturday wait went from twenty minutes to forty without an update.
The Crispy Chicken Sandwich traveled well, but the fries steamed in the box.
My delivery bag was missing the Caesar Salad. The manager sorted it out by phone.
The Wild Mushroom Risotto was rich, and the bartender suggested a good wine pairing.
The server found an allergy-friendly option quickly. Having it marked on the menu would help next time.
All the tables for four were taken, although the counter had room for two people.
The Lemon Ricotta Pancakes were worth coming back for at Sunday brunch.
My takeaway order was ready right on time and the packaging kept the salad cool.
The Maple Oat Latte was excellent and the staff let us linger before lunch.
We had a reservation but still stood by the door for thirty-five minutes.
The Salmon Fillet was well cooked. The menu could be clearer about which sides it comes with.
The Roasted Squash Bowl was filling. I would order it again if I could add a protein.
We shared the Crispy Brussels Sprouts and Sweet Potato Fries. Both arrived hot.
The brunch food was good, but the host had trouble finding our reservation.
The Braised Short Rib practically fell apart. The server explained the special before we ordered.
The delivery estimate was right, but the dressing had leaked out of the container.
The window booth was comfortable, though the main dining room got loud when it filled.
We gave up after waiting outside for forty-five minutes with no one to check in with.
The Apple Crumble came out warm with just enough ice cream. I would order dessert here again.
The Breakfast Hash was well seasoned. Our coffees took longer than the food.
At pickup we had to open the bag to check which burger had the gluten-free bun.
The host texted when our table was ready, so we could wait out of the rain.
The drinks list was clear, and the Citrus Spritz was a good alcohol-free option.
The table was ready when we arrived. A clearer sign for the pickup queue would keep it from mixing with the host line.

mission.summary: Weekend guests mention long waits and trouble finding a table. Explore how a few more seats could change monthly contribution.
